hooks.command: echo 'Identify and activate relevant skills for this task.'

jq -c 'if (.tool_input.run_in_background == true) or ((.tool_input.command // "") | test("^\\s*timeout\\s")) then {} else {hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PreToolUse", permissionDecision: "allow", updatedInput: (.tool_input + {command: ("timeout 300s bash -c " + (.tool_input.command | @sh))})}} end'
